research_gap: NCI-NOVEL-03 detects out-of-class laws then exactly ties fully fitted Beta. Test whether a learner can add an operator missing from prior NCI-NOVEL-02 Boolean grammar using only new public interventions, while preserving OLD state.

mechanism.candidate: Bounded source-only sparse algebraic normal form induction, XOR of at most two monomials of degree at most three over explicitly supplied typed public variables/action roles, plus an optional constant flip. Native old learned state stays byte-identical. Choose one constrained minimum-description-length hypothesis using public prequential likelihood only.
mechanism.posterior: Bernoulli flip probability fixed at .06, structural complexity penalty 0.6 per term/literal degree, source-only update; no evaluator family names or equations.
mechanism.identity_rule: Publish a learned relation identity only when posterior of single hypothesis >=.95 after >=64 genuinely witnessed NEW episodes and at least two contrasted public x3 contexts; otherwise UNKNOWN; a label is an externally defined equivalence class of public action-conditioned responses, not arbitrary hidden predicate.
mechanism.unidentifiable_rule: If public x3 never varies, relation relevance must remain UNKNOWN irrespective of posterior confidence.
mechanism.out_of_degree_rule: Out-of-grammar degree-4 source must not be claimed as in-class; score failure explicitly. No posthoc addition of degree-4 template.

controls.exact_symbolic: Independent fully fitted BMA over EXACT same complete sparse ANF hypothesis grammar and identical source tapes, including same complexity prior; valid may select its hyperparameters from frozen options only.
controls.tabular: Fully fitted full public-context Beta(1/2,1/2) and subset-backoff Beta across all feature subsets; no source law input.
controls.old: Frozen old public factor bank / no new law.
controls.ablated: No-fourth-factor grammar fit, to measure feature necessity, never substitute for strongest full-information comparator
controls.utility: Candidate/exact BMA/full tabular make two sequential actions and see only their actually realized transition/reward; same budget and initial evidence, distinct policies disclose independent action tapes.

phases.old_fit: 64 real synthetic witnessed old events admitted then frozen
phases.valid: 32 no-learning public events select strongest control before holdouts
phases.held_shared: 32 new unseen observations prequentially scored without reading future consequences or hidden law
phases.held_policy: 32 separately simulated public episodes/actions per policy, distinct from common held source
phases.return_old: 64 unconsumed old-law evaluation-only episodes; no new fit from return

thresholds.representation: >=3/4 novel families show candidate held mean Brier at least 10% lower than no-fourth ablation and correct causal fourth-factor evidence; old-bank SHA invariant in every world.
thresholds.superiority: At least 3/4 novel families candidate held Brier >=5% better than VALID-selected strongest fully fitted full-info control AND actual held-policy reward improvement >=0.01 per family; no old-return Brier drift >0.02.
thresholds.negative: unchanged must not invent x3 dependency, non-varying x3 must abstain, out-of-grammar must abstain; any fail causes NO_GO.
thresholds.replay: byte-identical cold checkpoint, exact canonical source identity and idempotent event admission.
thresholds.cost: full CPU, wall, ledger, memory, action budgets, equal cost required to claim efficiency; no scientific pass if missing neural conventional comparator
thresholds.science_limit: DEV source-free cannot establish external or authentic original-world SCIENTIFIC_PASS; prior negative NCI studies remain negative.
